d9e27c3f-07b9-4dec-9a5a-7bf10a521053.title: Magic Scholar
d9e27c3f-07b9-4dec-9a5a-7bf10a521053.description:
Certan was the prince of the demon world who wrecked havoc a long time ago. His father, the king of the demon world, had his soul sealed in an octagonal tablet and he sent to the human world…

By accident, he got stuck with a boy named Go Jinyoung…

‘Let’s conquer the martial world with magic!’

The popular martial arts novel, Magic Scholar, returns as a webtoon!

b8faa8ab-cb4e-416f-829d-d2a6042ba5ac.title: Ikoku Nikki
b8faa8ab-cb4e-416f-829d-d2a6042ba5ac.description: Makio Kodai (35), a novelist, cannot bear to see her niece Asa (15) being passed around by relatives at the funeral of her sister and her husband, and decides to take her in on the spur of the moment. However, although she took her niece home, she came to her senses the next day and her natural shyness kicked in. Makio had forgotten how unsuitable she was to live with someone. Asa, on the other hand, is not shy and agrees to live with Maki, an "adult who is not like an adult," in an unusual but honest way. This is the story of when two polar opposite worlds awkwardly try to interact.

164eff7a-e949-4edf-8531-1664d2a8771d.title: Himuro no Tenchi: Fate/school life
164eff7a-e949-4edf-8531-1664d2a8771d.description:
A comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/hollow ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou.  
  
It tells about the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede and Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata.  
  
The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits.

7e51aec5-7df3-4961-aa8f-5645d34f8944.title: Isekai Arigatou
7e51aec5-7df3-4961-aa8f-5645d34f8944.description:
“Listen up, right now, there's a super important and urgent question! …Am I cute?”

Chiba and Shiina, a pair of single otaku males around 30 meet during a high school reunion! Shortly after hitting it off with each other, they're thrown into one misfortune after another, and before they know it… they've been reincarnated as pretty babes in another world!

2e3d6fd1-6cd3-4497-bff7-f749c26e4497.title: Moto Seikishidan, Ima wa Chukyu Boukensha.: Meikyuu de Suterareta Dorei ni Gohan o Tabesasetara Natsukaremashita
2e3d6fd1-6cd3-4497-bff7-f749c26e4497.altTitle: Former Holy Knight, Now a Mid-Level Adventurer: I Fed an Abandoned Slave in a Dungeon, and Now She’s Attached to Me
2e3d6fd1-6cd3-4497-bff7-f749c26e4497.description:
かつて聖騎士団において次期団長と目されていた男・ファレルは、一身上の都合によって退団し、冒険者として暮らしていた。昇級試験を受けず、何年も中級冒険者で居続ける彼は、周囲の人々から『実力はあるが変人でもある』と言われていた。

派手な仕事には手を出さず、パーティも組まず、地道に生きるファレル。しかし彼には一つだけ譲れない目的があった。迷宮にある美味な食材を持ち帰ることである。

ある日ギルドの受付嬢から、上位パーティのメンバーが迷宮で取り残されているらしいという話を聞いたファレルは、食材探しのついでにという名目で様子を見に行くことにする。

そこで見たものは、戦うためだけに連れられてきた奴隷が一人で魔物と戦い続けている姿だった。ファレルは奴隷を救出するが、奴隷を見捨てた主人に返すわけにはいかず、傷ついた奴隷をファレルが介抱することになる。

ファレルは知らなかった。自分が引き取った奴隷が抱えている秘密――そして、彼が追い求めた美味なるものを他人に振る舞ったとき、何が起きるのかを。

9d985413-87c5-4990-9007-d5f4139535f5.title: Gakuen no Madonna no Watanabe san ga, Naze ka Maishu Yotei wo Kitekuru
9d985413-87c5-4990-9007-d5f4139535f5.altTitle: The School's Madonna, Watanabe-san, for Some Reason Asks My Schedule Every Week
9d985413-87c5-4990-9007-d5f4139535f5.description: Ryoichi Aikawa adalah seorang siswa SMA yang lebih memilih menghabiskan masa mudanya untuk memancing sendirian daripada mengejar asmara. Baginya, ketenangan di pelabuhan adalah segalanya—sampai suatu hari ia menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang digoda oleh pemancing nakal. Siapa sangka, gadis itu adalah Watanabe-san, sang "Madonna" sekolah yang sangat populer. Sejak pertemuan tak terduga itu, sang idola sekolah entah kenapa mulai tertarik dengan hobi memancing Ryoichi dan selalu menanyakan jadwal akhir pekannya.

b221ae9e-8763-4bed-b0ca-9e5f13f00f58.title: Okan
b221ae9e-8763-4bed-b0ca-9e5f13f00f58.description:
Osaka, 1955, in the town of Tsuten-Kaku.  
  
She left that stale life from her drunken husband, alone that night with her son. Looking for a new path without knowing how life will turn out to be. Her son was her last hope, there was nothing left behind.  
Her struggle will determine what kind of life her son will achieve, but nothing shapes the world better than a mother's determination and love. There was nothing she couldn't achieve. If you're looking for a story about a strong hero fighting against all odds. You'll look no further, and won't find anything like it thereafter…

chapters.title: A Bowl Which is Full of Love

c9eb1854-c6c2-49f5-a206-e66da6fda9c7.description: Nanoha Takamachi, now age 13, and her friends work as magical girls!

9f646ffa-2f4e-4ad2-9aed-1452194369c8.title: A Summer Shower
9f646ffa-2f4e-4ad2-9aed-1452194369c8.description: Little Geuroo was curious about him. That boy from next door who asked him a strange question. The boy, Lee Garam, who always avoided him even though all Geuroo wanted was to get close to him. But before Geuroo could even confess, Garam disappeared in thin air, leaving only clusters of blue light behind. And then, one summer, he appeared in front of Geuroo as if nothing happened…?

f4c3056d-22be-4f5c-97c6-25ce566f8f7f.title: [2♡♡8 Youth] Unrequited Love Defense
f4c3056d-22be-4f5c-97c6-25ce566f8f7f.description:
There are times in our youth that are awkward, messy, and unforgettable that stay with us forever. In the heart of adolescence, this is the story of first love. 

Mingyu has quietly loved his childhood friend, Jiwoo, for as long as he can remember.
Every time she laughs, complains, or casually drifts closer, his feelings deepen slowly but surely. The problem? Jiwoo has always had a thing for a very specific type: big, muscular "beast-like" guys. That's the total opposite of Mingyu. Thankfully, she’s never seriously liked anyone in real life so Mingyu has stayed in his role as the dependable “guy friend,” standing loyally by her side. But one calm autumn day, his peaceful world is shattered. “Joo Mingyu… I think I’m in love.” Out of the blue, Jiwoo falls head over heels for Kang Taemin, the captain of the school volleyball team. Now faced with the terrifying possibility that this might be her first real love, Mingyu realizes: it’s do-or-die. Determined not to lose her, he sets out on a last-ditch mission to become her ideal type… even if it means becoming a swole “muscular man” overnight!

2cb7b6df-4eeb-4f91-af76-af5bf3f6032b.title: Distance Between You and Me
2cb7b6df-4eeb-4f91-af76-af5bf3f6032b.description: I love you- I wonder if you like me back? And if you don't, well, I will slowly work to forget you…

b43f7770-4da7-4744-a4bc-41c45e8f4052.title: Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise
b43f7770-4da7-4744-a4bc-41c45e8f4052.description: Peleliu - Rakuen no Guernica follows the daily lives of Japanese soldiers taking part in the Battle of Peleliu during World War II: a high-casualty, months-long campaign. The main character, Tamaru, dreams of returning home to become a mangaka, and sees their island outpost as a wild paradise that can one day be used as a setting for one of his stories. Most of his comrades, however, are prepared for the more realistic scenario – that they will not be leaving Peleliu alive.

28b8be97-44f2-4bc7-8164-f9ae8ff85491.title: Kon'ya Coin Laundry de Aimashou
28b8be97-44f2-4bc7-8164-f9ae8ff85491.altTitle: See You at the Laundromat Tonight
28b8be97-44f2-4bc7-8164-f9ae8ff85491.description:
Narita, a family restaurant employee in his late twenties who is always busy with work, is feeling down about the results from his job interview. While having dinner one night, he's absentmindedly watching a video recommended to him on a streaming site.

The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and amazing singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky attitude.

Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar... That's when he realises it's Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.

18cce48d-3267-4bb5-9892-3de448fe2846.title: Hametsu o Hikaeta Akuyaku Reijou ga Muri Shite Heroine o Enjita Kekka: Taida na Yosei ga Akogare Nanoni, Daini Oji no Dekiai Route ni Konwakuchu
18cce48d-3267-4bb5-9892-3de448fe2846.altTitle: The Villainess Facing Ruin Forced Herself to Play the Heroine
18cce48d-3267-4bb5-9892-3de448fe2846.description: A former corporate slave from a black company has reincarnated as Serafina, the villainess of an otome game!  Being a villainess is way too much work for her. Having already slaved away enough for a lifetime in her past world, she’s determined to spend this new existence in absolute, blissful laziness...!  With that goal in mind, her plan was simple: avoid her own destruction just to secure a life of unlimited naps. However, for some reason, the affection levels of the characters around her just won't stop rising...

b3e639ca-cedb-4d7d-af03-9b17e9a76c1b.title: Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu (Kyouwakoku-hen)
b3e639ca-cedb-4d7d-af03-9b17e9a76c1b.altTitle: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs (Republic Arc)
b3e639ca-cedb-4d7d-af03-9b17e9a76c1b.description: Although Leon saved the kingdom—and even the world—from crisis, he hears from Marie that the game actually has a sequel. If the same kind of events that Marie triggered were to happen in the Republic as well, the world could be headed toward destruction once again. To prevent that crisis, Leon and Marie, along with the others, arrive in the Republic of Alzer as exchange students—but then...!?
